nodes.label: Node
nodes.question: Decide what counts as an actor, object, place, or event before we measure anything else.

nodes.label: Edge
nodes.question: Name the relation. Is it a tie, transfer, collaboration, sequence, or something else?

nodes.label: Weight
nodes.question: Choose what makes one connection stronger, more frequent, or more consequential than another.

nodes.label: Boundary
nodes.question: Set the system boundary so that the graph has a meaningful scope, not merely a convenient one.

nodes.label: Time
nodes.question: Choose the time scale: moment, period, sequence, or a series of snapshots.

nodes.label: Evidence
nodes.question: Link each connection back to observable data and record what the data cannot establish.

nodes.label: Claim
nodes.question: Turn a visible pattern into a narrow, testable claim—and state its uncertainty.
